components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The decisive action on an operational surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.375rem; min-height:2.75rem; padding:.625rem 1rem; border:0; border-radius:.5rem; background:var(--color-primary-solid, #b45309); color:#fff; font:600 .875rem/1.25rem 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .12); transition:background-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--color-primary-hover, #92400e); } .ds-btn-primary:active { background:var(--color-primary-active, #78350f); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, #b45309); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: A secondary action that preserves the flat structural hierarchy.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:2.75rem; padding:.625rem 1rem; border:1px solid var(--border-color, rgb(15 23 42 / .14)); border-radius:.5rem; background:rgb(var(--card, 255 255 255)); color:rgb(var(--text-muted, 75 85 99)); font:600 .875rem/1.25rem 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition:color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:rgb(var(--bg-muted, 243 244 246)); color:rgb(var(--text, 3 7 18)); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, #b45309); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A quiet tertiary action for low-risk controls and icon actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; min-height:2.75rem; padding:.625rem 1rem; border:0; border-radius:.5rem; background:transparent; color:rgb(var(--text-muted, 75 85 99)); font:600 .875rem/1.25rem 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition:color 180ms ease, background-color 180ms ease; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background:rgb(var(--bg-muted, 243 244 246)); color:rgb(var(--text, 3 7 18)); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, #b45309); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: The canonical compact field for configuration and search.
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:.3125rem; color:rgb(var(--text-muted, 75 85 99)); font:500 .8125rem/1.25rem 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:2.75rem; padding:.5625rem .75rem; border:1px solid var(--border-color, rgb(15 23 42 / .14)); border-radius:.5rem; background:rgb(var(--bg, 255 255 255)); color:rgb(var(--text, 3 7 18)); font:400 .875rem/1.5rem 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; outline:none; transition:border-color 180ms ease, box-shadow 180ms ease; } .ds-input:focus { border-color:var(--color-primary, #b45309); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #b45309) 18%, transparent); }

components.name: Operational Status Badge
components.description: A semantic status label that pairs text with a compact signal dot.
components.css: .ds-badge-up { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:.25rem; padding:.1875rem .5625rem; border-radius:999px; background:rgb(var(--success-bg, 240 253 244)); color:var(--success-fg, #15803d); font:500 .75rem/1rem 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing:.01em; } .ds-status-dot { width:.375rem; height:.375rem; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The default flat container for grouped operational content.
components.html:
Needs attention

Review monitors that are down or awaiting a first check.
components.css: .ds-card { padding:1.5rem; border:1px solid var(--border-color, rgb(15 23 42 / .14)); border-radius:.75rem; background:rgb(var(--card, 255 255 255)); color:rgb(var(--text, 3 7 18)); font:400 .875rem/1.5rem 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card strong { display:block; font-weight:600; } .ds-card p { margin:.25rem 0 0; color:rgb(var(--text-muted, 75 85 99)); }

components.name: Active Navigation Link
components.description: The selected application destination with a restrained leading marker.
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:2.75rem; padding:.625rem .75rem; border-radius:.5rem; background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #b45309) 12%, transparent); color:var(--color-primary, #b45309); font:500 .875rem/1.3125rem 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration:none; box-shadow:inset 3px 0 0 var(--color-primary, #b45309); transition:background-color 120ms ease, color 120ms ease; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-primary, #b45309) 16%, transparent); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, #b45309); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Monitor Card
components.description: The signature status-first row for a monitored service.
components.html: API healthOperationalhttps://api.example.com/health99.98%uptime
components.css: .ds-monitor-card { position:relative; display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.75rem; padding:1rem 1.25rem; overflow:hidden; border:1px solid var(--border-color, rgb(15 23 42 / .14)); border-radius:.75rem; background:rgb(var(--card, 255 255 255)); color:rgb(var(--text, 3 7 18)); text-decoration:none; font-family:'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; transition:border-color 180ms ease; } .ds-monitor-card:hover { border-color:var(--color-primary, #b45309); } .ds-monitor-card:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--focus-ring, #b45309); outline-offset:3px; } .ds-monitor-rail { position:absolute; inset:0 auto 0 0; width:2px; background:var(--success-fg, #15803d); opacity:.6; } .ds-monitor-copy { min-width:0; flex:1; display:grid; gap:.125rem; padding-left:.5rem; } .ds-monitor-heading { display:flex; align-items:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:.5rem; } .ds-monitor-copy strong { font-size:.875rem; font-weight:600; } .ds-monitor-copy code { overflow:hidden; color:rgb(var(--text-muted, 75 85 99)); font:400 .75rem/1rem 'JetBrains Mono Variable', 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; text-overflow:ellipsis; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-monitor-metric { display:grid; justify-items:end; color:rgb(var(--text-muted, 75 85 99)); } .ds-monitor-metric strong { color:var(--success-fg, #15803d); font:600 .875rem/1.25rem 'JetBrains Mono Variable', 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; } .ds-monitor-metric small { font-size:.6875rem; }

components.name: Error Alert
components.description: A structural semantic alert with a clear recovery action.
components.html: !We couldn't load your monitors.
components.css: .ds-alert { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:.75rem; padding:.875rem 1rem; border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--danger-fg, #b91c1c) 30%, transparent); border-radius:.75rem; background:rgb(var(--danger-bg, 254 242 242)); color:var(--danger-fg, #b91c1c); font:400 .875rem/1.25rem 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-alert-mark { display:grid; width:1.5rem; height:1.5rem; place-items:center; flex:none; border:1px solid currentColor; border-radius:50%; font-weight:700; } .ds-alert span:nth-child(2) { flex:1; } .ds-alert button { min-height:2.75rem; padding:.625rem 1rem; border:1px solid currentColor; border-radius:.5rem; background:transparent; color:inherit; font-weight:600; cursor:pointer; } .ds-alert button:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb, currentColor 8%, transparent); } .ds-alert button:focus-visible { outline:2px solid currentColor; outline-offset:3px; }

narrative.overview:
Pingflare is a calm operational vantage point: always alert, never theatrical. The interface uses a restrained, dependable visual vocabulary so self-hosters can scan status, identify risk, and act without decorative noise competing with live system truth.

The system is flat and structural. Hierarchy comes from neutral surface shifts, fine borders, compact spacing, and disciplined typography; Signal Amber is reserved for the active path and decisive actions. Light and dark themes are equally first-class, with the same information hierarchy expressed through paired neutral roles rather than separate visual personalities.

The product should feel calm, precise, and self-possessed. It rejects glossy SaaS spectacle, oversized marketing typography inside the application, and color used without operational meaning.
keyCharacteristics: Flat surfaces separated by fine borders and tonal shifts
Compact 44px controls with gently curved corners
Signal Amber used sparingly for action and active state
Inter for interface clarity; JetBrains Mono for operational data
Equal visual discipline in light and dark themes

rules.name: The Signal Economy Rule
rules.body: Signal Amber is scarce: use it for the primary action, active location, focus, or a meaningful selected state—not as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Status Truth Rule
rules.body: Green, red, caution, and pending colors describe real system state. Never use them decoratively or let color carry status without text or icon support.

rules.name: The Operational Readability Rule
rules.body: Use mono type for data that benefits from stable character widths, never as a general-purpose technical costume. Everything else stays in Inter.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: If a border or tonal shift can establish the relationship, do not add a shadow. Elevation belongs to transient layers and focused interaction.

dos: Do keep operational state, freshness, and required action visually dominant over decoration.
Do use Signal Amber sparingly for primary actions, focus, selection, and active navigation.
Do preserve 2.75rem minimum interactive height and visible keyboard focus.
Do use neutral surface shifts and one-pixel borders as the default hierarchy mechanism.
Do reserve JetBrains Mono for URLs, identifiers, intervals, percentages, and aligned technical evidence.
Do carry the same semantic hierarchy into dark mode rather than merely inverting colors.
donts: Don't use the legacy #ff6633 Tailwind-config orange as a new visual source of truth; the rendered system uses Signal Amber.
Don't add glossy gradients, glass surfaces, or broad decorative shadows to routine application UI.
Don't use success, danger, warning, or pending colors without genuine system meaning and a non-color cue.
Don't introduce oversized marketing headlines or a separate display typeface inside the authenticated application.
Don't place shadows on every card; reserve elevation for transient layers and interaction response.
Don't replace labeled operational actions with unexplained icon-only controls.
